text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime p95/p99 detector triggered for service inference-api-eu. p95=420ms (baseline 180ms), p99=4.8s (baseline 620ms). Alert ID ALRT-4321. https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/ALRT-4321 :loud_sound:

alice_ops: ack. paging oncall. I'm on it — starting the quick checklist.

bob_sre: joining. seeing spike scoped to eu-prod only? also seeing streaming stalls and long tail on chunk-write.

carla_prod: heads-up — two enterprise customers (acme-inc, mediapp) showing elevated timeouts and degraded streaming UX. @emily_support can you check open CS tickets?

emily_support: on it, pinged CS leads and opened customer check-ins. will update.

dinesh_eng: quick triage plan: 1) verify if routing shifted to heavy model variants 2) check KV cache hit rates and eviction logs 3) inspect autoscale/backpressure and node OOMs. I can flip route to fallback if needed.

alice_ops: dashboards: p95/p99 timeseries https://dash.internal/redwood/d/p95-99?range=15m — sharp jump at ~14:03 UTC. node-level shows GPU queueing on some pods.

bob_sre: logs show repeated "kv_cache_miss" + "streaming_writer_timeout" around the spike timestamp. also a couple of OOM-kills on host-gpu-7. suspect kvcache evictions -> regen -> longer decode times.

carla_prod: customer impact note: partial streaming timeouts (client RTT > 10s) for some sessions. non-fatal but very bad UX. PMs notified.

alice_ops: runbook step1: initiate route-shift to eu-fallback (lower-capacity but lower tail). I'll start 50% -> fallback now.

dinesh_eng: also suggest temporary token cap for streaming endpoints and increase kvcache retention window. commands I'll run: 
```
# route shift to fallback 50%
rcli route update --service inference-api --region eu --policy fallback --pct 50
# increase kvcache TTL on node (quick patch)
kubectl -n infra exec kvcache-0 -- sh -c "echo 120 > /etc/kv_cache/ttl"
```

bob_sre: after route-shift p99 dropped from 4.8s -> 1.1s within ~60s, p95 back to ~230ms. :thumbsup:

emily_support: CS updated ACME and MediApp with mitigation steps (shorter responses, retry guidance). ACME acknowledged and will monitor.

alice_ops: leaving incident note: create ticket INC-2026-4321, include dashboards, logs, and mitigation timeline. suspects: kvcache eviction + node OOM. mitigation: route-shift, kvcache TTL increase, token cap. handing to @dinesh_eng for follow-up.

dinesh_eng: taking ownership. will roll back route-shift after autoscale + kv config tuned. initial hypothesis: recent kvcache GC rollout 2h ago may have been too aggressive. digging in.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4321 created and assigned to dinesh_eng. Severity: Sev2. https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-4321

alice_ops: closing live paging for now. will re-open if p99 regresses. if stable for 15m we mark handoff complete. thanks all.

bob_sre: notes for follow-up: collect heap dumps from host-gpu-7, kvcache eviction logs, and upload traces to the incident ticket.
